chapter_title: Concerning the Five War[s that the] Sons of [Li]gh
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Five Combats of the Divine Against Falsity from Evil

---

**¶1:**
Those who are in wisdom from the Divine waged five complete spiritual combats against those who are in falsity from evil. Those who are in wisdom conquered and subdued those who are in falsity in every engagement.

---

**¶2:**
The first combat is that of the Divine Human as to the celestial degree, which was waged against the ruling love of self that governs all the states of falsity, and all the dominant evils that had proceeded from the five sensory degrees of the natural mind in their perverted state [GAP-1]. He captured them by means of his encompassing truth, which is the living perception of good. He [GAP-2] in the restraint of divine order and [GAP-3] the appearance of the [GAP-4] his pure and uncorrupted love, the living ardor of celestial affection [GAP-5] — they found no way to escape his encompassing truth [GAP-6] — he seized upon their natural cognitions as one draws fish from the deep [GAP-7] — the five deliberations of the five faculties of the perverted sensory mind [GAP-8]. He severed and uprooted the inmost principle of the five degrees of perverted perception, [GAP-9] the root of false understanding, as the power of truth severs what is contrary to order.

---

**¶3:**
The second combat is that of the Divine Truth proceeding from the Lord [GAP-10]. This Divine Truth established the forms and states of heavenly order; it extended the dominant falsities and restrained them in the midst of that order [GAP-11] — the knowledges of good and truth in [GAP-12] — the natural states of the mind [GAP-13] — within the three containing forms of the celestial, the spiritual, and the natural degrees. For the dominant falsities revolted and set themselves against the Divine Truth. They wished to [GAP-14] — since they perceived and recognized that the Divine Truth might bind and confine them with the strong bonds of divine order. Yet the Divine Truth appeared to them in many manifestations, with numerous [GAP-15], with manifold powers and severe judgments. It was revealed to them; it imprisoned them with consummate wisdom. Not one of these falsities was able to preserve itself, and {GAP-16}[GAP-17] [GAP-18]. Now, since [GAP-19] it confined them [GAP-20] [GAP-21].

---

**¶4:**
The third combat is that of the Third Emanation of Divine Wisdom, which manifested its form [GAP-22] — toward what is in the natural and sensory degrees [GAP-23] — drew out [GAP-24] — all wisdom and the goods belonging to it [GAP-25] — those states that are consumed and dissipated by evil [GAP-26] — the entire dominion of self-love [GAP-27] — the glory of wisdom [GAP-28] — extending it throughout all degrees [GAP-29]. A power comes forth, which is the Lord as to omnipotence [GAP-30]; he takes back the spiritual riches that evil had usurped [GAP-31], the truths it had profaned [GAP-32], and its self-exaltation and concupiscence.

---

**¶5:**
This is the nature of the dominion of self-love [GAP-33]: all spiritual knowledges it had seized [GAP-34] — as they progress through successive states [GAP-35] — wisdom [GAP-36]. The Divine Wisdom separated and purified truth from every admixture of falsity.

---

**¶6:**
The fourth combat is that which the Lord as to the fullness of Divine Love and Wisdom waged against all the evils and falsities that had revolted in the interior mind and in the external mind alike. When wisdom had been separated from them by the manifestation of the Third Emanation of Divine Wisdom, their restraints were loosened [GAP-37]. The Lord in the fullness of glory entered the fourth combat; he came and brought [GAP-38] — a revolt of the entire dominion of self-love. He girded himself with truth [GAP-39] — and subdued all of it yet again. He re-established the whole order of heaven and the church, and he made [GAP-40] — a great temptation combat, in which he conquered. [GAP-41] He fulfilled the Divine purpose of the Infinite, [GAP-42: REVIEW he gave the] interior perception of salvation to the natural will of humankind [GAP-43] — unto the doctrine of truth in which wisdom is carried.

---

**¶7:**
The fifth combat is that which the Divine Providence [GAP-44] — which is the calling forth of Divine Truth and the reception of it in the will [GAP-45] — the greatness of the Divine [GAP-46] — and it established [GAP-47] — upon the [GAP-48] — and the [GAP-49] [GAP-50] — of spiritual death, which [GAP-51] — together with all that belongs to it. And it was victorious over [GAP-52] — unto eternity, and it bestowed the heavenly kingdom [GAP-53].

---

*Note on translation:* The five wars correspond to five successive degrees of the Lord's combat against the hells — from the celestial (the Divine Human), through the spiritual (Divine Truth proceeding), through the manifest wisdom (the Ambassador), through the fullness of Love and Wisdom united (Jesus the Glorious), to the final work of Providence operating through the call and response that constitutes the living church. Each combat addresses a deeper or more comprehensive stratum of the dominion of self-love and falsity from evil, until the whole is subdued and heavenly order reigns.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The sons of light waged five wars against the sons of Darkness. The sons of light humiliated the sons of Darkness in them all.

The first war is that of the First living Man, which he waged against the King of the realms of Darkness, and all the rulers that had come forth from the five worlds of [Darkness]. He hunted them with his net, which is the living soul. He [caught them] in the snare and [revealed] the face of the [...] his virgin, the living fire [...] they did not find how to escape his net [...] he caught them like fish [...] the five counsels of the five elements [of Darkness]. He cut and dug out the root of the five trees, [and the] root of the evil tree, like an axe.

The second war is that of the Living Spirit [against the Darkness]. He has constructed the things and the worlds of light; he spread out the rulers and chained them in the middle [of the heavens and he set] the stars in [the firmament and he made] the earths [and placed] them in the three vessels. For the rulers rebelled and were set against the Living Spirit. They wished to [flee] since they knew and realised that he might bind and fetter them with a strong chain. Yet he, the Living Spirit, (appeared to them) with many aspects, with numerous [faces], with many hands and great cruelties. He was revealed to them, he imprisoned them with much skill. Not one of them was able to save (himself), and he [bound][in fetters]. Now, since he [...] he trapped them [...] [...].

The third war is that of the Third Ambassador who has displayed his image [to what is above and] what is below [and he] scooped [from them] all light and the property [of] the ones that are consumed [...] the entire ruling-power [...] pride of the light [...] extending it [...]. A person comes, who is powerful [over all]; he takes his riches [his gold], silver [...], his pride and wantonness.
This is what the ruling-power is like [one who has], all riches [...] as they travel [to the] light [...]. He cleansed and purified it.

The fourth war is this that Jesus the glorious one waged against all the rebels who had rebelled above and below. When the light was purified from them by the image of the Third Ambassador, their chains loosened [from them]. The glorious one in the fourth war; he came and brought [an end to] a rebellion of the entire ruling-power. He girded himself [with power and subdued] all of it another time. He constructed the whole structure and he made [with them] a great contest; he humiliated therein. [...] he fulfilled the will of the greatness, [he gave the] hope to Adam [...] to his light ship.

The fifth war is this that the counsel of life [has waged] which is the summons and the obedience [...] great [...] and it placed [...] upon the [...] and the [...] [...] of death, which [...] with it. And it was victorious over [death] for ever, and it gave the kingdom [...]

fills.explanation: The five worlds of Darkness is the standard Manichaean term for the five perverted sensory realms from which the rulers proceed, and the text already establishes "sons of Darkness" as the opposing party.

The hunting-with-a-net metaphor requires a verb of capture; the spiritual reading confirms restraint/capture in divine order, and "caught them in the snare" is the natural completion of the net/hunt imagery.

The spiritual reading says "the appearance of" which requires a verb of disclosure; "revealed the face" is the standard expression for manifesting the power of one's armor/soul in Manichaean combat narratives.

The five counsels and five elements belong to the dark side, corresponding in the spiritual reading to the five faculties of the perverted sensory mind; "of Darkness" completes the standard Manichaean formula.
The passage lists two parallel objects of the cutting action — the root of the five trees and the root of the evil tree — requiring a simple conjunction to connect them.

Following the pattern of the other war descriptions where the opponent is named, and since the Living Spirit's cosmogonic work follows from his combat against the forces of Darkness, this completes the war formula.

fills.fill: of the heavens and he set
fills.explanation: The Living Spirit chains the archons in the middle of the heavens (the firmaments) and then sets the stars; the spatial reference "of the heavens" completes "in the middle" while the verb "set" introduces the stars.
Stars are placed in the firmament in Manichaean cosmogony, and the Living Spirit's next creative act is making the earths from the bodies of the archons; this bridges the two acts.
The final act in the Living Spirit's sequence is placing the purified elements in the three vessels (sun, moon, and column of glory); "and placed" completes the list of cosmogonic actions.
The rulers knew the Living Spirit would bind them, so their natural wish was to flee; this accords with the spiritual reading's theme of falsities attempting to escape the bonds of divine order.

In the list "many aspects, numerous [X], many hands, great cruelties," the term "faces" is the standard ancient cosmological attribute for a divine being's manifold manifestations, fitting the parallel with "aspects."

The entire passage emphasizes imprisonment and fettering; after stating none could save themselves, the culminating action is binding, consistent with the chapter's dominant metaphor of chains and bonds of divine order.
The verb "bound" requires a direct object referring to the rulers who could not save themselves; "them" is the minimum grammatically necessary pronoun.
The passage repeatedly uses the language of binding and fettering ("bind and fetter them with a strong chain"), so "in fetters" completes the action of binding in the chapter's own vocabulary.

The Third Ambassador displays his image to the archons both above (chained in the heavens) and below (on earth); the "above and below" pairing is standard Manichaean cosmological vocabulary, and "what is below" already appears in the text.

With GAP-22 filled, the Third Ambassador "displayed his image to what is above and what is below" — a simple connector "and he" naturally transitions to his next action of scooping/drawing out the light from the rulers.

The Third Ambassador's display causes the archons to release the swallowed light; "scooped from them all light" describes the extraction of wisdom and good from the states of falsity, matching the spiritual reading's "drew out."

The genitive construction "the property of the ones that are consumed" describes the goods belonging to the states consumed by evil, completing the possessive relationship indicated in the spiritual reading.

The spiritual reading identifies this figure as "the Lord as to omnipotence"; in the parable register, "powerful over all" expresses universal sovereignty and directly translates the concept of omnipotence into the text's natural vocabulary.
Gold and silver form the standard ancient pairing of precious goods; gold corresponds to goods of love (Swedenborg) and naturally precedes silver in the list of riches stripped from the ruling-power.

The paragraph introduces a simile comparing the ruling-power to a wealthy figure whose goods are seized; "one who has all riches" establishes the parable comparison consistent with the strong-man/rich-man parable structure underlying this passage.

In Manichaean cosmology, the purified light particles travel to the light (the vessels of sun and moon); "as they travel to the light" describes the progressive purification journey corresponding to the spiritual reading's "successive states" leading to wisdom.

When the light was purified from the rulers by the Third Ambassador's image, the restraints that held them in place were loosened "from them," releasing them to rebel — which precipitates the fourth war.

The fourth war's explicit purpose is Jesus ending the rebellion that arose when the archons' chains loosened; "he came and brought an end to a rebellion of the entire ruling-power" directly states this combat's outcome, matching the spiritual reading's indication that the Lord subdued the revolt of self-love.

The spiritual reading specifies "girded himself with truth and subdued"; in the Manichaean register, truth manifests as power/armour, and the narrative requires a verb of conquest before "all of it another time."
The phrase "he made with them a great contest" follows the natural register of the Kephalaia for describing a combat engagement between the divine figure and the rebels.

The editor's fill is confirmed: the spiritual reading shows that the Lord gave the interior perception of salvation (hope) to the natural will (Adam), making "he gave the hope to Adam" the correct reading.

Following the pattern of the other four war descriptions where each divine figure's combat action is stated, "has waged" completes the formula: "the counsel of life has waged, which is the summons and the obedience."

Death is explicitly mentioned in the immediately preceding context, and the fifth war as the final cosmic combat culminates in ultimate victory over spiritual death — consistent with the spiritual reading's identification of the enemy as "spiritual death."
